label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled 'seg' parameter flows directly to redirect URL path without sanitization. While 'host' is validated against regex, the path segment '/[seg]' is fully attacker-controllable. Resolved sink value at line 24 is "https://" + host + "/" + seg where seg = request.getParameter("seg") (with null fallback to "home"). Attacker can inject path traversal (/../) or other malicious content into the redirect target path.

evidence.note: User-controlled seg parameter concatenated into redirect URL path without sanitization
